main.description: Write a label record into the subject's space. Requires label, or takedown for !hide and !takedown. On the host's own queue, a template, a version of one or a like of one is labelled by the host: !hide leaves it out of where people look for things to add, and unsafe, on a version, sends every tab on it back to the last version that isn't.

group.description: The group DID. Every method is served by the group's host and authorized against that group's roles. Or the host's own DID, for its queue of what's shared with everyone: templates, their versions, and likes of them, for the host's moderators alone.

schema.description: The label record a group's label is; nothing for the host's own, which it keeps itself.
